name: Niner Nation Silence 2024

venue.name: UNC Charlotte Popp Martin Student Union

information:
**NOTE: THERE IS NO STANDARD 3x3x3 CUBE EVENT HELD AT THIS COMPETITION. All competitors at all skill levels are welcome, however most of the events held at the competition are more advanced. The only two sighted events are 6x6x6 Cube and 7x7x7 Cube. The rest of the events are blindfolded or 3x3 Fewest Moves (which is writing out a solution to a scramble in 1 hour). We will NOT be teaching competitors how to do these events. Competitors are expected to know how to compete in the events they register for.**

Please always include your **name** and competition name in any email that you send to us.
All competitors must read the "Competitor Information" tab prior to registering.
Please read all tabs prior to the competition and regularly check your email for updates from us. All contact will be made by email.

Only **one** guest per competitor will be allowed.

**No outside food or drink is allowed in the venue**
